author: Neuronection
description: Live translation pad (palette: /tr). Opens straight into typing with an automatic source and your default target; change the direction and engine from the pad's Settings menu. Engines are configured under Tools → Translation.

en.title: Translate
en.description: Live translation pad (palette: /tr). Opens straight into typing with an automatic source and your default target; change the direction and engine from the pad's Settings menu. Engines are configured under Tools → Translation.
en.config.padDebounceMs.description: How long to wait after you stop typing before translating.
en.config.sourceCode.description: What the pad's Settings starts the source at — Automatic detects the language.
en.config.targetCode.description: What the pad's Settings starts the target at; the pad itself follows Tools → Translation until you apply a target.
en.config.engineMode.description: Configured default follows Tools → Translation; the other values override the engine for this pad only.
